about: Shared story bank for the reading games (Story Order, Read & Remember, True or False Race, Spot the Mistakes). 5 sentences per story, in order. tf: statements (a = true/false, fix = the correct fact). questions: short answers. mistakes: in sentence i, the right word(s) are swapped for a wrong form (Spot the Mistakes). Written for Kru in American English. At least 50 stories per level, shuffled every game.
